capabilities: Translate the selection in a popup window with language switching, copy, insert or replace
Translate whole notes into new sibling notes without overwriting existing files
Preserve Markdown syntax such as front matter, code, wikilinks, tags and tables during translation
Translate through Google Translate, DeepL or MyMemory, with automatic fallback to MyMemory
Detect the source language and cache session translations to avoid repeat requests
extras: The default Google Translate endpoint is an unofficial web address that Google can change or block. MyMemory has a daily limit unless an email is added. The plugin sends note prose to third-party services that keep their own logs. The listing is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: a successor to Translate, Language Translator and DeepL, none of which has been updated for two years
motivation: The author built it as a successor to Translate, Language Translator and DeepL, none of which had been updated for two years or more.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in translation, and the existing translation plugins (Translate, Language Translator, DeepL) have gone unmaintained.
